implementation.targetScope: Controlled navigation search widget used by FuseSearch: custom input and portaled suggestion rendering, first-result highlighting, input/selection/fetch/clear callbacks, keyboard and mouse selection, focus and ARIA. App adoption and authenticated UI acceptance are separate.

changes: Independent React runtime using vreact-themeable, vsection-iterator and vshallow-equal; no copied upstream runtime, legacy Promise shim or prop-types runtime.
Composition Enter cannot select a suggestion. Keyboard scrolling cannot let a stationary pointer overwrite the highlight.
Caller input refs are forwarded; unchanged rendered suggestion content retains DOM identity. Empty grouped results clear the active descendant and notify null.
Empty sections are omitted as documented upstream. shouldKeepSuggestionsOnSelect keeps the menu open on Enter; redundant unchanged-highlight notifications are suppressed.
Incremental typing reapplies first-result highlighting even when consecutive characters preserve the same filtered list; immediate Enter and arrow restoration are compared against upstream.

appContract.scope: Public fixture reproduces the controlled search, theme, custom input and portal-container contract with synthetic navigation labels. It does not copy private source or authenticate to VentiMath.

actualBrowser.scope: Unchanged FuseSearch with real MUI TextField/Popper and synthetic navigation in MemoryRouter. Ten-result cap, controlled value, rerender DOM/focus retention, arrow navigation, Enter and mouse route selection, no-results feedback and Escape. No authenticated app or deployment claim.

autosuggest-10.1.0-r2.symptom: The first-result highlight could disappear during character-by-character navigation searches, leaving Enter without a selection.
autosuggest-10.1.0-r2.cause: The input-change handler cleared the highlight, while unchanged filtered contents skipped the new-list highlight logic.
autosuggest-10.1.0-r2.verification: Six navigation queries typed at80ms per character, immediate Enter and ArrowDown/ArrowUp restoration; packed React19.1/19.2 browser controls and unchanged FuseSearch basic/full with synthetic routes.
